episodes.title: The Ghost Ship
episodes.description: A ship crashes into Whitby harbour with a dead captain and no crew.

scenes.narration: Last time, a storm drove a strange ship toward Whitby.
scenes.visual: A storm-lashed harbour at night, a ship looming out of the rain

scenes.narration: The Demeter crashes into the harbour in the dead of night.
scenes.visual: A schooner running aground in a raging storm, waves breaking over it

scenes.narration: Not a single sailor is on deck.
scenes.visual: The empty deck of a ship in pouring rain

scenes.narration: Only the captain, dead, his hands tied to the wheel around a crucifix.
scenes.visual: A dead sea captain lashed to a ship's wheel, a crucifix bound in his hands

scenes.narration: As the ship hits the shore, a huge black dog leaps from the deck.
scenes.visual: A huge black dog leaping from a ship's bow onto a beach

scenes.narration: It races up the steps to the clifftop graveyard and vanishes.
scenes.visual: A dark dog bounding up stone steps toward a clifftop churchyard

scenes.narration: The captain's log tells a nightmare.
scenes.visual: An open water-stained logbook beside a candle

scenes.narration: Night after night, his crew vanished, one by one.
scenes.visual: A lone sailor on watch in fog, a tall dark shape standing behind him

scenes.narration: The only cargo was fifty boxes of earth.
scenes.visual: Rows of wooden crates in a dark ship's hold

scenes.narration: The Count has arrived in England.
scenes.visual: A dark silhouette with red eyes on a clifftop above the town

episodes.title: The Figure on the Bench
episodes.description: Mina follows a sleepwalking Lucy and sees something terrible in the graveyard.

scenes.narration: Last time, the Count came ashore in Whitby as a great black dog.
scenes.visual: A black dog's silhouette on a cliff against the moon

scenes.narration: One night, Mina wakes to find Lucy's bed empty.
scenes.visual: Mina waking in a dark bedroom, staring at an empty bed

scenes.narration: The door is open. Lucy has sleepwalked out into the night.
scenes.visual: An open bedroom door, moonlight spilling into the hallway

scenes.narration: Mina runs through the streets to the clifftop churchyard.
scenes.visual: Mina in a shawl running through cobbled night streets toward a ruined abbey

scenes.narration: There, on their favourite bench, lies a white figure.
scenes.visual: A figure in white lying on a bench in a moonlit graveyard

scenes.narration: Something dark is bending over her.
scenes.visual: A long dark shape bending over a bench, silhouetted against the moon

scenes.narration: As Mina calls out, it lifts a pale face with gleaming red eyes.
scenes.visual: A pale face with glowing red eyes turning in the moonlight

scenes.narration: When she reaches the bench, Lucy is alone and cold.
scenes.visual: Mina wrapping her shawl around a sleeping Lucy on the bench

scenes.narration: On her throat are two tiny red marks.
scenes.visual: Close-up of two small puncture marks on a pale throat

scenes.narration: Mina thinks she pricked her with a pin. She is wrong.
scenes.visual: Mina frowning at a safety pin in her hand by candlelight

episodes.title: The Man Who Eats Flies
episodes.description: Mina finds Jonathan, while an asylum patient senses his master's arrival.

scenes.narration: Last time, Mina found two strange marks on Lucy's throat.
scenes.visual: Mina looking worriedly at Lucy asleep in bed

scenes.narration: Then a letter arrives. Jonathan is alive, in a hospital in Budapest.
scenes.visual: Mina reading a letter with tears of relief

scenes.narration: He escaped the castle, but his mind is shattered by fever.
scenes.visual: Jonathan pale and thin in a hospital bed, tended by nuns

scenes.narration: Mina rushes to him, and they marry at his bedside.
scenes.visual: Mina holding Jonathan's hand at a bedside wedding with a priest

scenes.narration: Back in England, Dr. John Seward runs an asylum near London.
scenes.visual: A gloomy Victorian asylum beside a walled estate at dusk

scenes.narration: His strangest patient, Renfield, eats flies.
scenes.visual: A wild-eyed man in a cell catching flies against a barred window

scenes.narration: Then spiders to eat the flies, and birds to eat the spiders.
scenes.visual: Renfield cupping a sparrow in his hands, spider webs in the corner of his cell

scenes.narration: He believes every life he eats makes him stronger.
scenes.visual: Renfield grinning, holding a jar of crawling insects

scenes.narration: Lately, he stares at the old empty house next door, Carfax.
scenes.visual: Renfield pressed against the bars, staring at a ruined mansion beyond the wall

scenes.narration: And he whispers, the Master is at hand.
scenes.visual: Close-up of Renfield's face grinning in the dark

episodes.title: The Professor Arrives
episodes.description: Lucy is fading fast, and a Dutch professor suspects the truth.

scenes.narration: Last time, a madman sensed his master moving in next door.
scenes.visual: The ruined Carfax mansion under a stormy sky

scenes.narration: In London, Lucy is wasting away, pale and weak, and no one knows why.
scenes.visual: Lucy pale in bed in a Victorian bedroom, Arthur at her side

scenes.narration: Dr. Seward sends for his old teacher, Professor Van Helsing, from Amsterdam.
scenes.visual: An elderly professor with a doctor's bag arriving at a London townhouse

scenes.narration: Van Helsing examines her, and goes very quiet.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing examining Lucy's throat with a magnifying glass

scenes.narration: She has lost a terrible amount of blood.
scenes.visual: Seward and Van Helsing exchanging grave looks beside the bed

scenes.narration: Arthur gives his own blood to save her.
scenes.visual: Arthur lying beside Lucy's bed during a Victorian blood transfusion

scenes.narration: Then Van Helsing fills her room with garlic flowers.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing hanging wreaths of white garlic flowers around a window

scenes.narration: He makes them promise not to remove them.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing raising a stern finger in warning in a dim bedroom

scenes.narration: That night, Lucy's mother finds the room stuffy.
scenes.visual: An elderly lady in a nightcap frowning at the garlic flowers

scenes.narration: She opens the window, and throws the garlic away.
scenes.visual: An open window, garlic flowers scattered on the floor, curtains blowing

episodes.title: Lucy's Last Night
episodes.description: A wolf, a death, and a terrifying change in Lucy.

scenes.narration: Last time, the garlic protecting Lucy was thrown away.
scenes.visual: Garlic flowers lying scattered on a moonlit floor

scenes.narration: Night after night, Lucy grows weaker, despite more transfusions.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing and Seward giving a transfusion by candlelight

scenes.narration: One night, a huge grey wolf smashes through her window.
scenes.visual: A great grey wolf crashing through a bedroom window in a shower of glass

scenes.narration: Her mother dies of fright, and Lucy is left alone until morning.
scenes.visual: Lucy alone in a moonlit room with torn curtains, tears on her face

scenes.narration: Now she lies dying, but something in her is changing.
scenes.visual: Lucy lying in bed, deathly pale, lips slightly parted

scenes.narration: Her teeth look longer, and sharper.
scenes.visual: Close-up of sharp teeth behind pale lips

scenes.narration: In a strange, soft voice, she begs Arthur to kiss her.
scenes.visual: Lucy reaching up toward Arthur with half-closed eyes

scenes.narration: Van Helsing pulls him back with surprising strength.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing seizing Arthur's arm and pulling him away from the bed

scenes.narration: Moments later, Lucy dies.
scenes.visual: Lucy lying still in bed surrounded by candles

scenes.narration: But Van Helsing whispers to Seward that this is only the beginning.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing speaking quietly to Seward in a dim hallway, faces grave
